meta.name: Power Rangers Cosmic Fury
meta.description: When Lord Zedd returns more powerful than ever, Team Cosmic Fury takes to the cosmos to battle the emperor of evil, and save the universe as we know it.

videos.name: Lightning Strikes
videos.overview: Bajillia enlists Lord Zedd to lead her armies in an intergalactic war — and things only get worse when the two capture a Power Ranger for their team.
videos.description: Bajillia enlists Lord Zedd to lead her armies in an intergalactic war — and things only get worse when the two capture a Power Ranger for their team.

videos.name: Beyond Repair
videos.overview: Team Cosmic Fury prepares for a possible invasion from Lord Zedd while Amelia tries to cure an evilized Ranger and Javi learns to accept his new loss.
videos.description: Team Cosmic Fury prepares for a possible invasion from Lord Zedd while Amelia tries to cure an evilized Ranger and Javi learns to accept his new loss.

videos.name: Off Grid
videos.overview: Stranded on a faraway planet with no powers, Team Cosmic Fury scrambles to figure out a way home while Earth suffers an invasion from enemy forces.
videos.description: Stranded on a faraway planet with no powers, Team Cosmic Fury scrambles to figure out a way home while Earth suffers an invasion from enemy forces.

videos.name: Team Work
videos.overview: Ollie races Team Cosmic Fury to find Zayto, but the Zenith Ranger's location is anyone's guess. They'd better move fast though: Lord Zedd's forces loom!
videos.description: Ollie races Team Cosmic Fury to find Zayto, but the Zenith Ranger's location is anyone's guess. They'd better move fast though: Lord Zedd's forces loom!

videos.name: Rock Out
videos.overview: When Bajillia discovers a long-lost Zord on a mining planet, the Rangers must create a musical distraction to stop her from using it as a war weapon.
videos.description: When Bajillia discovers a long-lost Zord on a mining planet, the Rangers must create a musical distraction to stop her from using it as a war weapon.

videos.name: Take Off
videos.overview: Solon goes missing right as the Rangers prepare to fly the base back to Earth. But the team has bigger problems: Ollie's tracker has led him to Erridus.
videos.description: Solon goes missing right as the Rangers prepare to fly the base back to Earth. But the team has bigger problems: Ollie's tracker has led him to Erridus.

videos.name: Operation Seasoning
videos.overview: To save Pine Ridge, Team Cosmic Fury must dismantle the system of Squidrills creating an anti-Zord forcefield around Earth — with the help of a spy.
videos.description: To save Pine Ridge, Team Cosmic Fury must dismantle the system of Squidrills creating an anti-Zord forcefield around Earth — with the help of a spy.

videos.name: Switching Sides
videos.overview: Two ex-villains should be the last people to cure Ollie, but Aiyon has a plan that just might work. Meanwhile, Zayto's secret becomes harder to hide.
videos.description: Two ex-villains should be the last people to cure Ollie, but Aiyon has a plan that just might work. Meanwhile, Zayto's secret becomes harder to hide.

videos.name: Master Plan
videos.overview: The connection to the Morphin Grid is in danger, unless the team can travel to Eltar and take back the Master Captivator and Ollie — without backup.

videos.name: The End
videos.overview: If Team Cosmic Fury can't stabilize the Master Captivator, a wave of pure evil threatens to wipe out all the good in the universe. No pressure, right?
